events.name: MARKET_UPDATED
events.description: The market state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, chart, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: market update, equilibrium, surplus, shortage, price change

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: SHIFT_DEMAND
events.description: Learner pressed a Demand +/- button to shift the demand curve's intercept.

events.name: SHIFT_SUPPLY
events.description: Learner pressed a Supply +/- button to shift the supply curve's intercept.

events.name: SET_PRICE
events.description: Learner dragged the price slider to set the market price.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Demand Intercept
overridableConfigKeys.description: Choke price — the price at which quantity demanded falls to zero (P = intercept − slope × Q); the demand curve's starting vertical intercept.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: demand, choke price, maximum willingness to pay, demand curve intercept, demand function

overridableConfigKeys.label: Demand Shift Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: How much the Demand +/- buttons move the demand intercept per press.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: demand shift, demand shock, shift in demand

overridableConfigKeys.label: Demand Slope
overridableConfigKeys.description: How much price falls for each additional unit demanded — the magnitude of the demand curve's downward slope.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: demand slope, price sensitivity, demand curve steepness

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Spacing between gridlines on the canvas, in data units (quantity/price).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Price
overridableConfigKeys.description: Starting price on the price slider, before the learner adjusts it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Price (axis)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Top edge of the price axis, and the price slider's maximum, in currency units.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Quantity (axis)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Right edge of the quantity axis, in units.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Price Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Slider increment for the price control.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Supply Intercept
overridableConfigKeys.description: Reservation price — the minimum price at which producers begin supplying (P = intercept + slope × Q); the supply curve's starting vertical intercept.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: supply, reservation price, minimum supply price, supply curve intercept, supply function

overridableConfigKeys.label: Supply Shift Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: How much the Supply +/- buttons move the supply intercept per press.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: supply shift, supply shock, shift in supply

overridableConfigKeys.label: Supply Slope
overridableConfigKeys.description: How much price rises for each additional unit supplied — the magnitude of the supply curve's upward slope.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: supply slope, marginal cost slope, supply curve steepness
